title: 第3章 光明神王体第4章 第一个天命主角叶不凡
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
姜族驻地内，一股浩然气息从姜夜身上直冲而起。
冲霄的金色光柱仿佛击穿苍穹。
璀璨金光于万丈洒落，似是福泽苍生。
仙光萦绕！
霞光万里！
万兽俯首！
虚空中，金光漫天，法则意象不断交织，绚烂无比。
一道艳红倩影破空而立，美眸注视着神子行宫。
“夜儿这是后天觉醒了另外一种体质？”
苏红夜目光柔和，冷霜的俏脸上带着些许担忧：“倒是希望他普通点，毕竟家里什么都不缺，多娶几百个儿媳，生一堆子孙开枝散叶，过逍遥日子不好吗？”
显然，她是认真的。
姜夜要是听到，免不了又是心中一阵吐槽。
这软饭他也想吃啊。
但就怕吃不了几年，就被天命主角们连根拔起了。
“咦，奇怪！”
“神子这是觉醒了什么体质？为何没有引动天道雷劫？”
“对啊，这是为何？”
姜族驻地中，异象遍布，很快引起了族中不少人注意。
就连后山深处，躺在棺材板的数十位老祖都被惊醒，一道道声威浩荡的身影鱼贯而出，悬立于半空。
苏红夜秀眉微蹙，沉声道：“别看了，让族人散开，封锁消息！”

她也注意到了此事的奇怪之处。
从神子宫发出的强大气息中，可以判定姜夜是觉醒了某种强大的体质，但她一介大帝竟看不出个所以然来。
“何种体质？为何只有异象，没有引发雷劫？”
她低声喃喃着。
姜夜表示，系统出品，非纯天然的光明神王体。
不归天道管。
嘻嘻~
顿时，冲天的磅礴金光洒下，天地间仿佛只剩下淡金色的虚无世界。
惊鸿一瞬。
一切归于平静。
众人晃过神来，已然过去了整整一个时辰。
后知后觉。
令人惊惧不已。
苏红夜当即撕裂虚空，瞬息间进入神子宫，身影落在姜夜身前。
“夜儿？”
content_en:
In the Jiang Clan's camp, a majestic aura rushed straight from Jiang Ye.
The golden light beam soaring into the sky seemed to penetrate the sky.
The bright golden light spreads across the sky, seeming to bless the common people.
Fairy light lingers!
The sun shines brightly!
All beasts bow their heads!
In the void, golden light fills the sky, and the images of laws are constantly intertwined, and they are extremely gorgeous.
A bright red shadow stood in the sky, her beautiful eyes staring at the palace of the Son of God.
"Ye'er has awakened another physique the day after tomorrow?"
Su Hongye's eyes were soft, and there was a little worry on Leng Shuang's pretty face: "I hope he can be more ordinary. After all, the family has everything. Wouldn't it be nice to marry hundreds more daughters-in-law, give birth to a bunch of descendants, and live a happy life?"
Clearly, she means it.
If Jiang Ye heard this, he would inevitably complain in his heart again.
He also wants to eat this soft rice.
But I'm afraid that within a few years, I'll be uprooted by the protagonists of Destiny.
"Hey, that's weird!"
"What kind of physique has the Son of God awakened? Why didn't he trigger the Heavenly Thunder Tribulation?"
"Yes, why is that?"
Strange phenomena were everywhere in the Jiang clan's camp, which quickly attracted the attention of many people in the clan.
Even the dozens of ancestors lying on the coffin boards deep in the back mountain were awakened, and majestic figures came out one after another, hanging in the air.
Su Hongye frowned slightly and said in a deep voice: "Stop looking, let the clan members disperse and block the news!"
She also noticed something strange about it.
From the powerful aura emanating from the Divine Palace, it could be concluded that Jiang Ye had awakened some kind of powerful physique, but she, the Great Emperor, could not figure out why.
"What kind of physique? Why are there only visions and no thunder disaster?"
She murmured quietly.
Jiang Ye said that the body produced by the system is not a purely natural King of Light.
No return to heaven.
Hehe~
Suddenly, the majestic golden light soared into the sky, and there seemed to be only a pale golden void world left between heaven and earth.
A moment of shock.
Everything is calm.
Everyone was stunned. A whole hour had passed.
Hindsight.
It was terrifying.
Su Hongye immediately tore through the void, entered the Divine Palace in an instant, and landed in front of Jiang Ye.
"Ye'er?"
